card.title: Nintendo DS Lite not turning on

source.title: Nintendo DS Lite not turning on

claims.statement: DS Lite: charges but won't turn on with green flash = check screen ribbons and Wi-Fi module (startup test fails without them), fuse F2, Wi-Fi module.
Doesn't charge or turn on = check fuses F1 and F2, filter EM10 by the charge port, and the power connector.
Power switch SW13: pins 2–3 shorted at rest; pin 1 shorts to 2/3 when pressed.
Replace fuses with proper 0603 fuses (about 0.5 A, unverified), not wire.

procedure: Check ribbons and Wi-Fi module seating.
Check F1, F2, EM10 and the power connector.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Bridging a fuse with wire can cause more damage.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
